_comment_: Phase 5 local-dev realm. Phase 12 templates render per-Deployment realms via gocloak at provisioning time; this file is the bootstrap-only template (foundations §8 anti-pattern: do not re-import to apply config drift).

clients._comment_: Phase 5 client. ADR 007: production swaps to one client per Deployment with audience saas-data-<dep_id>; the audience-mapper here is named in the same way so the swap is mechanical.
clients.name: SaaS Data Plane (local dev)

protocolMappers._comment_: tenant_id is the authoritative tenancy claim. The user attribute is set by the platform at user-create time; the mapper copies it into the access token. Foundations §8 reminds us audience MUST be validated before tenant_id is read.
protocolMappers.name: tenant-id-attribute

_comment_idps_: Identity provider brokers. credentials carry placeholder values; the operator populates real client_id / client_secret via gocloak (or OpenBao KV bridge in Phase 6) before turning a Deployment on. The 'alias' field maps to /v1/users/{id}/social-providers/{provider} — keep in sync with identity.Provider.Valid().

identityProviders._comment_: Apple Sign-In requires the operator to fill team_id, key_id, client_id, and private_key (.p8) from the Apple Developer Program. Without those it stays disabled. Form-post response mode is required.
